name: Bertille Althusser
original_name: ベルティーユ・アルチュセール
source: Bertille is a second-year student whom Mio had a run in with, and who considers Mio her rival. She is easily embarrassed by being seen in e.g. her school swimsuit, but brazen enough to wear a thong during a joust. Coming from a wealthy family, Bertille owns several mansions located near the school.
